description: Canonical solution registry per Directive §16. 8 solution families with capabilities, use cases, and CTAs.

solutions.title: AI & Agentic Systems
solutions.description: Build governed multi-agent orchestration platforms where AI agents execute specialized roles across departments, with human CEO oversight, immutable audit trails, and deterministic routing.
useCases: Non-Profit Full Capability with Minimal Staff (FOW-04)

solutions.title: Intelligent Automation
solutions.description: WhatsApp-native assistants, automated document pipelines, and intelligent form workflows that connect teams to tools without app downloads — running on infrastructure people already use.

solutions.title: Data & Decision Intelligence
solutions.description: Automate donor-ready reports from Kobo and DHIS2 data in hours, not weeks. Clean data, generate narrative reports against donor templates, and build interactive dashboards accessible on mobile.

solutions.title: Digital Transformation

solutions.title: Strategy & Executive Advisory
solutions.description: Structured discovery, AI readiness assessments, boardroom briefings, and roadmap generation — helping leadership teams move from problem to governed AI deployment with clarity.

solutions.title: AI Governance & Policy

Model Comparison & Benchmarking on Local Infra
